name: humid_air_1691_economizer_fan_refused
description: Hot-day morning window cooling (economizer) with humid outdoor air (dew point ~67F): the economizer does not start the fan; the AC keeps the band
notes: Dew points: indoor 78F at 46.8% = 56.02F; outdoor 72F at 84.3% = 67.0F (at or above the 65F ceiling). The dry twin is the golden economizer-cool-down-to-maintain (same temperatures, no humidity): cool-down engages.

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: deleting the economizer guard makes 07:00 read the economizer's fan activation (cool-down) instead. (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Humid-air guard (Issue #1691)' states this rule and production applies it through humidity_facts.humid_air_verdict. (c) occupant: the economizer's fan would push 67F-dew-point morning air through the house while the AC tries to dry it.

verdict.summary: No economizer fan on humid air

events.note: Hot day, as in the golden economizer-cool-down-to-maintain.
Morning window, direction favourable: by temperature the economizer would engage cool-down.

assertions.reason: The economizer's fan start is refused on humid air.
